full_suite.note: 116 default tests + PhotoVisionTest, PhotoCatalogUiTest and BudgetOptimizerUiTest run separately under Xvfb with the verified model; 8 optional tests (5 MySQL, 3 legacy UI) not re-run in this session

limits: No general camera recognition accuracy benchmark
No live prices or exact price capture dates
USD inferred from US-store context; no original currency column

Photo search tested on the enlarged catalog: held-out retailer images still rank the correct product first for the three checked groups, but this is a small functional check, not an accuracy benchmark
actual_maven_javafx_launch: Passed: native Tulita window and the 79-product catalog observed under Xvfb
ui_redesign: Verified under Xvfb: navy rail, KPI hero, per-retailer prices, spread badge, comparison chart for Walmart/Amazon/Target
ratings: Not available in the four pinned CSVs; no rating column and no rating specification key. Displayed as Not in source rather than invented.
price_history: One undated observation per retailer; recorded-price-by-retailer chart only. No temporal trend is fabricated.

budget_optimizer.algorithm: Pareto dynamic programming (exact for the stated model), integer cents, delivery once per retailer, state cap 20000 with reported fallback
budget_optimizer.export: CSV via Apache Commons CSV; printable output through JavaFX PrinterJob (a PDF printer in the OS dialog yields a PDF)
limits: one product per category repeated by quantity
prices are historical observations, not live
delivery charges and discounts are user-supplied assumptions
warranty/specification criteria are dropped and disclosed when the catalogue has no data
budget_optimizer.per_line_charges: LineCharges: delivery apportioned within each retailer's lines, discount across all lines, remainder to the largest line, so the per-line final costs sum to the basket total to the cent
budget_optimizer.what_if: Explore Alternatives: complete alternative requests (budget +/-10%, each other mode, optional category, one less unit, any brand, relax a minimum spec, drop charges), re-optimised off the UI thread, with a signed change report (total, remaining, score, item count, swapped products)
budget_optimizer.saved_plan_viewer: View opens the stored plan (mode, timestamp, totals, every line, recorded limitations)
budget_optimizer.currency: budget can be entered in INR: the shopper supplies the rate (Tulita never invents one), the optimiser still runs in the recorded catalogue currency, and every displayed amount is labelled with the assumption; an INR-priced catalogue needs no code change; a mismatched currency is refused, never converted
budget_optimizer.score_display: plain average per item plus the weighted score the active mode maximises
